NORM "" -> 1
NORM "/" -> 1
NORM "/a" -> 1
NORM "/a/b" -> 1
NORM "/a/b/c" -> 1
NORM "a" -> 0
NORM "//" -> 0
NORM "/a//b" -> 0
NORM "/a/" -> 1
NORM "/a/b/" -> 1
NORM "/a//" -> 0
ITER "/a/bb/ccc":
  COMP "a" remaining="/bb/ccc"
  COMP "bb" remaining="/ccc"
  COMP "ccc" remaining=""
  END remaining=""
ITER "/":
  COMP "" remaining=""
  END remaining=""
ITER "/single":
  COMP "single" remaining=""
  END remaining=""
ITER "/a/b/c/d":
  COMP "a" remaining="/b/c/d"
  COMP "b" remaining="/c/d"
  COMP "c" remaining="/d"
  COMP "d" remaining=""
  END remaining=""
ITER "":
  END remaining=""
